name: Quote Share Box
author: AppZoic

sections.description:
Quote Share Box – Copy & Share Quotes** is a simple and stylish plugin that lets you display quotes with:

  • A red background image (customizable)
  • Copy-to-clipboard functionality
  • Share buttons for WhatsApp, Facebook, and Telegram
  • Easy shortcode usage: [mahesh_quote]Your quote here[/mahesh_quote]

Perfect for love, anniversary, or motivational quotes.

Features

  • Clean, responsive design
  • Font Awesome icons
  • Works with any theme
  • No JavaScript libraries required
  • Lightweight and SEO friendly

Usage

After activating the plugin, use this shortcode in your posts or pages:

[mahesh_quote]“Your quote goes here.”[/mahesh_quote]<h3>License</h3>

This plugin is licensed under the GPL v2.0 or later.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory or upload the ZIP via WordPress Admin > Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” menu in WordPress.
  3. Use the [mahesh_quote]...[/mahesh_quote] shortcode wherever you want to display the quote box.
sections.faq:
Can I change the background image?

Yes! You can edit the plugin CSS or override it in your theme’s stylesheet.

Does this plugin support other languages?

The quote content itself can be in any language (e.g., English + Bengali). Currently, plugin text is minimal and in English.

Will this work with Elementor/Gutenberg?

Yes, simply paste the shortcode into a Shortcode block or text widget.
